rules: If mseccfg.MML is 1 and the matching PMP entry has configuration bits L=0, R=0, W=0, and X=0, any access to the region results in an access-fault exception for both M-mode and S/U-mode.

If mseccfg.MML is 1 and the matching PMP entry has configuration bits L=0, R=0, W=0, and X=1, an access in M-mode results in an access-fault exception, and an access in S/U-mode results in execute-only permission.

If mseccfg.MML is 1 and the matching PMP entry has configuration bits L=0, R=0, W=1, and X=0, an access in M-mode results in read/write permission, and an access in S/U-mode results in read-only permission.

If mseccfg.MML is 1 and the matching PMP entry has configuration bits L=0, R=0, W=1, and X=1, an access in M-mode results in read/write permission, and an access in S/U-mode results in read/write permission.

If mseccfg.MML is 1 and the matching PMP entry has configuration bits L=0, R=1, W=0, and X=0, an access in M-mode results in an access-fault exception, and an access in S/U-mode results in read-only permission.

If mseccfg.MML is 1 and the matching PMP entry has configuration bits L=0, R=1, W=0, and X=1, an access in M-mode results in an access-fault exception, and an access in S/U-mode results in read/execute permission.

If mseccfg.MML is 1 and the matching PMP entry has configuration bits L=0, R=1, W=1, and X=0, an access in M-mode results in an access-fault exception, and an access in S/U-mode results in read/write permission.

If mseccfg.MML is 1 and the matching PMP entry has configuration bits L=0, R=1, W=1, and X=1, an access in M-mode results in an access-fault exception, and an access in S/U-mode results in read/write/execute permission.
If mseccfg.MML is 1 and the matching PMP entry has configuration bits L=1, R=0, W=0, and X=0, any access to the region results in an access-fault exception for both M-mode and S/U-mode.

If mseccfg.MML is 1 and the matching PMP entry has configuration bits L=1, R=0, W=0, and X=1, an access in M-mode results in an access-fault exception, and an access in S/U-mode results in an access-fault exception.

If mseccfg.MML is 1 and the matching PMP entry has configuration bits L=1, R=0, W=1, and X=0, an access in M-mode results in execute-only permission, and an access in S/U-mode results in execute-only permission.

If mseccfg.MML is 1 and the matching PMP entry has configuration bits L=1, R=0, W=1, and X=1, an access in M-mode results in read/execute permission, and an access in S/U-mode results in execute-only permission.

If mseccfg.MML is 1 and the matching PMP entry has configuration bits L=1, R=1, W=0, and X=0, an access in M-mode results in an access-fault exception, and an access in S/U-mode results in an access-fault exception.

If mseccfg.MML is 1 and the matching PMP entry has configuration bits L=1, R=1, W=0, and X=1, an access in M-mode results in an access-fault exception, and an access in S/U-mode results in an access-fault exception.

If mseccfg.MML is 1 and the matching PMP entry has configuration bits L=1, R=1, W=1, and X=0, an access in M-mode results in an access-fault exception, and an access in S/U-mode results in an access-fault exception.

If mseccfg.MML is 1 and the matching PMP entry has configuration bits L=1, R=1, W=1, and X=1, an access in M-mode results in read-only permission, and an access in S/U-mode results in read-only permission.
